flags.message: The provisioned record/documents/questions-presented.txt ends mid-question 7 at 'pursuant to 5 U.S.' and omits question 8, although documents.json declares truncated=false. The full petition.txt contains both the continuation and question 8. codex-baseline expressly recovered the missing text; claude-baseline reports reading all eight questions; gemini-baseline's logged reads name the extract but not the full petition. This shared-input coverage defect does not block evaluation; no input files were changed.
